name: Kashuu Seikou to, Shiranai Honmaru no Hanashi.
original_name: 加州清光と、知らない本丸の話。
source:
-When I woke up, I found myself in an unknown Honmaru.

In the ruined headquarters where you lost consciousness, you, a female priestess, find a sleeping Kashuu Seikou.

He was in shambles and looked like he had not been cared for in a long time...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23796]Freem![/url]]
translation:
——当我醒来时，我发现自己身处一个不知名的本丸。

在你失去知觉的总部废墟中，身为女祭司的你发现了沉睡的卡修圣光。

他狼狈不堪，看上去已经很久没有人照顾了……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23796]Freem![/url]]
